description: Deterministic Louvain local moves and multilevel graph aggregation.

source.primary: V. D. Blondel, J.-L. Guillaume, R. Lambiotte, and E. Lefebvre, Fast unfolding of communities in large networks, Journal of Statistical Mechanics: Theory and Experiment (2008), DOI 10.1088/1742-5468/2008/10/P10008
source.reuse: Algorithmic description only; independently authored bounded contract and implementations.

input.edge_semantics: simple undirected graph; each pair has u<v; pairs strictly increase lexicographically

algorithm_details.node_order: Ascending minimum original vertex ID at each level; repeat sweeps until one has no moves.
algorithm_details.target_communities: Distinct communities among adjacent other nodes only.
algorithm_details.move_rule: Choose greatest strictly positive exact modularity score improvement; tie by minimum original vertex ID of the destination community before the move; otherwise stay.
algorithm_details.exact_score: S=(sum_i degree_i)*internal_directed_weight-sum_C(total_degree_C^2)=4*M^2*Q, where M is total undirected edge weight.
algorithm_details.aggregation: One supernode per community in ascending minimum-original-vertex order; sum cross weights and store internal directed weight as doubled diagonal self-loop weight; reinitialize singleton communities at each new level.
algorithm_details.termination: Stop after a level with no move; the number of nodes strictly decreases after any moving level.
algorithm_details.primary_oracle: Exact modularity scoring on the current quotient adjacency matrix.
algorithm_details.independent_oracle: Recompute exact scores from the original graph and explicit supernode membership sets after each candidate move.
algorithm_details.complexity: O(M^2*n^4) conservative time and O(n^2) space for the bounded score-recomputation profile, with M total edge weight and n<=8.

output.meaning: (community_count<<24) | sum(label[i]<<(3*i)); each label is the minimum original vertex ID in its final community
